description: Mulberry silk is the highest quality silk available for purchase. The unique thing about Mulberry silk is how it is produced. Mulberry silk has its history in China, where local farmers grow mulberry leaves for silkworms to feed on. The resulting cocoons are spun into raw Mulberry silk fibres.
Mommes (mm) are units of weight traditionally used to measure the density of silk. It is similar to the use of thread count for cotton fabric. The higher momme number the thicker.

It has long been a secret of the beauty industry that silk pillowcases can make an amazing difference to the appearance of your skin. Wrinkles appear smoother and there are no creases or marks from the pillowcase.

Wake up in the morning with hair that is smooth as silk. The natural proteins present in silk together with its amazing smoothness mean that your hair doesn't get matted or dried out when your head rests on silk overnight. .That's why top models always insist on silk pillowcases.

Silk pillowcases, sheets and duvet covers are easy to launder. They can be machine washed at 30℃ on the gentle or hand washable cycle of your washing machine using a gentle, non-biological soap or a specialist silk detergent .Washed in this way will give you years of life, because we always insist the finest, most durable, heavyweight silk.
